text:
Sam (AcmeHealth): Hey team, saw unexpected KMS decrypt activity from our Dedicated tenant during the 02:00 UTC window. Not sure if it's a legit job. Can you pull audit logs and check service account creation?

alice_chen: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the decrypt log ID or sample event?

Sam (AcmeHealth): Here's the entry: `requestId=8a3f-... decrypt keyId=projects/acme-tenant/keys/rdw-kms-01 principal=svc-updater@acme-dedicated` — we don't have any svc-updater in our catalog.

maria-g: :eyes: copying that. First pass: might be a compromised svcacct or a rogue automation. We'll need the full audit slice and associated IAM events. Sam, can you confirm whether any recent RBAC changes were approved?

Sam (AcmeHealth): No RBAC changes in the last 30 days. I already rotated the app credentials for one app but that shouldn't touch KMS keys.

benji: I'm pulling Dedicated control plane logs for tenant "acme-tenant" between 01:30-03:00 UTC. Will grep for `svc-updater` and `DecryptKey`.

secops-bot: [alert] High-risk KMS decrypt from unknown principal detected for tenant acme-tenant at 2026-02-17T02:07:12Z.

benji: Found 3 decrypt events with that principal. Also see a `CreateServiceAccount` event at 2026-02-17T01:58:44Z coming from ip 18.205.34.12 (cloud-run region-us-west2).

alice_chen: Stop any automated jobs that might be running under tenant context and rotate the KMS key policy to deny new decrypts while we investigate. Maria, can you do the key policy change? Benji, can you suspend the service account?

maria-g: On it. Executing temporary policy patch to set `deny: decrypt` for bindings from all service accounts except the listed allowlist. Patch applied at 02:20 UTC. Snippet: ```PATCH /v1/keys/rdw-kms-01:setIamPolicy {"policy":{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter","members":["user:security@acme.com"]}]}}```

benji: I disabled the `svc-updater@acme-dedicated` service account in the tenant control plane at 02:22 UTC. Also revoked active tokens and removed it from any service principals.

Sam (AcmeHealth): Thanks. Any sign of data exfil? Which buckets or outputs were touched?

jay-sre: From network logs, there were two outbound requests to `s3.amazonaws.com` from a managed agent process between 02:08-02:12 UTC. Need the object names — currently pulling storage access logs.

benji: Storage access logs show a PUT to `acme-tenant-logs/exports/2026-02-17/02-08-41.json` initiated by `svc-updater`. We're preserving the object and snapshotting it now.

maria-g: Triage summary: service account created by a cloud-run job with a compromised CI secret. KMS used to decrypt a credentials blob which then uploaded to customer storage. Containment steps done: disabled svcacct, revoked tokens, applied temporary key deny policy, preserved storage object.

alice_chen: Next steps for customer: 1) Rotate any keys that may have been decrypted (we recommend creating a new key and re-encrypting). 2) Customer to rotate CI secrets and audit runners. 3) Redwood to run a full entitlement audit and provide logs. Sam, can you confirm you want Redwood to rotate the key or will Acme handle it internally?

Sam (AcmeHealth): Please rotate the KMS key and assist with re-encrypting our active secrets. We're opening an internal incident too.

maria-g: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate KMS key rotation with infra steps and provide a playbook. Target ETA for complete rotation and re-encrypt: 4 hours.

alice_chen: I'll compile a timestamped packet of all audit logs and the preserved object and share via secure transfer. Also filing a ticket to run a vuln sweep on CI runners for leaked tokens.

secops-bot: [incident] Incident created #INC-2026-2483 assigned to security-oncall. Priority: P1.

Sam (AcmeHealth): Appreciate the quick response — please let me know if you find evidence of other principals or unknown egress.

benji: Will follow up with signed storage snapshot + MD5 and a short list of affected objects.

maria-g: Will post the rotation ops and commands in the incident ticket. For transparency: we'll redact any customer secret contents before sharing.

alice_chen: Post-incident action items: CI token TTLs review, enforce least-privilege on key bindings, add a KMS decrypt anomaly alert to secops-bot for that tenant. Assigning owners in the ticket. :lock: :white_check_mark:

Sam (AcmeHealth): Thanks all. Closing loop when rotation complete.
